cab: The garbage truck's low-entry crew cab, side skin cut away: the driver behind the steering wheel and dashboard on the far side, a crew member in an orange hi-vis jacket on the near side, the windscreen, wing mirrors, two amber roof beacons, the golden-yellow cab front.
engine: The diesel engine low under the yellow cab, cut away: engine block, turbocharger and silver pipes, the radiator at the front behind the grille, the gearbox, the exhaust pipe, the front wheel below and the charcoal-grey bumper.
wheels: The rear twin wheels of the garbage truck: one pair of black tyres side by side with grey steel hubs on the rear axle, the charcoal-grey wheel arch, the chassis, the drive shaft running forward, the hopper end of the yellow body above.
fuel: The big silver diesel fuel tank on the steel chassis rail between the axles, with its filler cap and straps, the drive shaft and chassis around it.
hydraulics: The black hydraulic oil tank with a sight glass and the hydraulic pump with brass fittings on the chassis, thick black hoses rising up to the yellow body, the fuel tank beside it.
body: The garbage truck's yellow box body cut open: rubbish bags, cardboard, bottles and packaging squashed tightly in layers, the steel walls and ribs, the red-and-white stripe along the bottom.
ejector: The ejector plate at the front of the body: a ribbed steel wall standing in the rubbish, the long shiny telescopic hydraulic cylinder behind it, hydraulic hoses, the cab wall beside it.
packer: The packer in the tailgate: the big curved steel sweep blade on its slide plate, two shiny hydraulic cylinders above it, rubbish being pushed up into the body, the yellow tailgate frame.
hopper: The open hopper at the bottom of the yellow tailgate: a scoop-shaped steel trough with rubbish bags, rubbish falling in from the tipped green bin, a grab handle, a worker's cap below.
lifter: The bin lifter on the back of the truck: steel comb teeth hooked under the rim of a green wheeled bin turned upside down, rubbish falling out into the hopper, the lifter arms, a lamp post at the left.
lights: The top of the yellow tailgate: two amber warning beacons, red rear lights and a small reversing camera above the hopper opening, against plain paper.
crew: Two refuse workers in orange-and-yellow high-visibility clothes at the back of the yellow truck: one pressing the lifter button on the control panel, one rolling a green bin across the paving stones, a tabby cat watching, the rear step and the lifter.
bins: Green wheeled bins standing on the paving-stone pavement, a worker in orange hi-vis rolling one of them, the base of a lamp post.
